question.text: Per the current SIA workbook (January 2026), a Social Enterprise that raises funds using the Social Stock Exchange (SSE) must submit its Annual Impact Report (AIR):

answer.text: Within 30 days of FY-end in Form RODD-A
Within 60 days of FY-end in Form RODD-A
Within 90 days of FY-end in Form RODD-A
As specified by SEBI from time to time — the workbook references the AIR being provided by October 31 each year or before the income-tax-return due date, whichever is later

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 210 of the current SIA workbook states that Social Enterprises raising funds using the SSE provide the assessed AIR by October 31 each year or before the income-tax-return due date, whichever is later; page 211 notes that AIR is submitted in the format and time as specified by SEBI. The older 90-day Form RODD-A framing is not supported by the 2026 workbook pages checked. The Trap: 30, 60, and 90 days are distractors aligned with LODR financial-result timelines; 90 days reflects the older Form RODD-A claim that is no longer the current rule per the SIA workbook. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XXIII and III-A/III-C Compliance both test the AIR/SSE-disclosure regime; the AIR submission timeline should be cited from the current SEBI circular rather than memorised.
